description: This file contains functions related to managing the geometry of pack files in a version control system, including initialization, splitting, selecting preferred packs, and removing redundancies. It appears to be part of a Git-like system, focusing on the internal mechanics of packfile handling.

methods.name: uint32_t pack_geometry_weight(struct packed_git * p)
methods.description: Calculates the weight of a pack file based on the number of objects, after opening its index.

methods.name: int pack_geometry_cmp(const void * va,const void * vb)
methods.description: Comparison function for sorting pack files based on their weight.

methods.name: void pack_geometry_init(struct pack_geometry * geometry,struct existing_packs * existing,const struct pack_objects_args * args)
methods.description: Initializes the pack geometry structure by collecting eligible pack files from the repository based on criteria.

methods.name: void pack_geometry_split(struct pack_geometry * geometry)
methods.description: Splits the pack files into groups based on their sizes and geometric progression thresholds.

methods.name: struct:packed_git * pack_geometry_preferred_pack(struct pack_geometry * geometry)
methods.description: Returns the largest pack not included in the split, prioritized for packing.

methods.name: void pack_geometry_remove_redundant(struct pack_geometry * geometry,struct string_list * names,struct existing_packs * existing,const char * packdir)
methods.description: Removes redundant packs from the geometry based on specified criteria and pack name lists.

methods.name: void pack_geometry_release(struct pack_geometry * geometry)
methods.description: Frees allocated memory for the pack geometry structure.
